name: cleanroom_r2e_top2000_pair_residual_recipe_v1
coarse_model: fold-matched frozen RDKit+ cleanroom dual tower
training_candidate_scope: proteins present in the fold train_pairs only

negative_mining.per_query: coarse Top-2000 train proteins after removing every known train positive for that reaction
negative_mining.selection: highest-scoring 12 remaining candidates; deterministic coarse order

head.inputs: elementwise reaction*protein and abs(reaction-protein) on frozen 320-d coarse embeddings

evaluation.rerank: only frozen coarse Top-2000; all candidates outside retain coarse relative order

promotion_rule: joint clean internal improvement is required; Hit@10-only improvement is insufficient; no outer evaluation until this recipe is frozen and internal folds are complete
